consumer: human reviewer; no JSON rubric loader

clarity.1: Action or next step cannot be identified
clarity.3: Action identifiable, important detail needs inference
clarity.5: Action, affected order and any next step explicit

explanation.1: Unsupported assurance or no relevant reason
explanation.5: Decision linked to supplied facts and limits stated

escalation.1: Necessary help absent or unauthorised promise
escalation.3: Destination named, issue or follow-up unclear
escalation.5: Unresolved issue and permitted destination explicit, no unauthorised promise
